adherence.reason: The story centrally follows Elara and Julian's anonymous courtship and romantic meeting.
The narration deliberately uses corny jokes, hearts, blushing, synchronized gestures, and an explicit rom-com tone.
The piece is a compact, self-contained short story.
Elara and Julian are the two commuter protagonists.
Their recurring anonymous exchange is centered on the designated train seat and its backrest.
They exchange unsigned notes without knowing each other's names until the delay reveals them.
An unexpected delay stops the train between stations with both characters together in the carriage.
Elara explicitly accidentally reads her latest note aloud to the carriage.
The exact required sentence appears verbatim as the note Elara reads aloud.
In the concluding scene, both characters sign their real names on the same note.
